description: Fires when column 4 (just right of centre) is full and the opponent's stone is on top, strongest when that top stone sits on my stone and was the opponent's last move; activation decays over the following few plies. Top stone mine, or col 4 at heights 3-5: no firing. Early-game variant: col 4 holds exactly two stones, theirs on top (ply <= 8). Context adds a lot of unexplained variation.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to zero or to max moves column probabilities by at most about 0.05.
notes: Core pattern confirmed by minimal pairs: col4 full with their top stone gives 2-4 (synthetic), top X gives ~0, O-on-O ~1.1 vs O-on-X ~2.9; decays ~4.1->2.3->1.4->1.1 over 6 plies; them completing another column re-boosts. Simple 'col4 full top theirs' rule: recall 0.99 but precision 0.24 (F1 0.386). Adding recency: F1 0.464 (P0.36 R0.66), sim share 0.55. Top-row-count, full-column bonuses did not help. Much context-dependent variance remains (layer 2).
